# ===========================================================================
# THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR THE TAG SET -- TWO TIERS, AND THE DIFFERENCE
# BETWEEN THEM IS A HARD API LIMIT, NOT AN EDITORIAL CHOICE.
# ===========================================================================
#
# TIER 1 -- [TOPICS]. GitHub repo topics. Capped at TWENTY by the server; the
#   API rejects the 21st. Nothing we write here changes that. These are the
#   structured, browsable tags: each becomes a crawlable github.com/topics/<t>
#   page, which is the highest-value surface we have.
#
# TIER 2 -- [SIGNATURE]. The README signature block. **NO LIMIT.** This is
#   visible markdown text, and visible text is what was MEASURED to survive
#   GitHub's sanitizer intact (POST api.github.com/markdown: <meta> deleted,
#   display:none stripped-but-rendered, plain "#tag" text survives verbatim).
#   This is the true descendant of the forum signature, and it is where an
#   unlimited tag set belongs. Put everything true here.
#
# The 20-cap applies ONLY to tier 1. Capping tier 2 at 20 would be throwing
# away the one surface that has no cap.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE RULE THAT GOVERNS BOTH TIERS: every tag must name something that is
# GENUINELY PRESENT. tag-manager.yml enforces this mechanically for tier 2 by
# scanning the actual trees of both accounts -- Saimonokuma and
# Nova-Violet-Role -- and refusing any tag it cannot find evidence for. That is
# why "unlimited" is safe here: the generator cannot invent a tag, so a longer
# list is a more complete description rather than a bigger lie.
#
# CORRECTED 2026-08-01 -- THE RULE ABOVE WAS THE DEFECT.
#
# It used to read: "Tier 2 draws from the two ACCOUNTS plus this repo's tree. A
# tag naming a language or a subject that appears in NEITHER ACCOUNT is a defect."
# Scoping the evidence to the OWNER's accounts is what put `python`, `c`,
# `compiler`, `rolling-context` and `context-compression` on this repository:
# all five are true of Saimonokuma's other work (Chaos-SymbioseOS is C,
# GHC-COMPILER-PYTHON is Python, claude-rolling-context-Lean-4- is the rolling
# context) and every one of them is FALSE HERE.
#
# A topic is a claim about the REPOSITORY THAT CARRIES IT. Nobody searching
# `topic:python` wants a repo whose author writes Python elsewhere; they want
# Python. The account scan may SUGGEST candidates, it may never JUSTIFY one.
#
# THE RULE, corrected: every tag in either tier must be true of THIS TREE, and
# for any tag naming a language that is decidable -- `git ls-files` must find
# files of it. checker/tags-consistency.sh phase 6 decides exactly that, with
# two controls, and it is a gate.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# -- true of THIS repository, not of its neighbours
#
# AUDITED 2026-08-01, and five tags were CUT here: python, c, compiler,
# rolling-context, context-compression. They arrived under the heading
# "present in the org / owner accounts", which is a true statement about the
# OWNER and a false one about this repo -- and a topic is a claim about the
# repository that carries it, never about its author's other work.
#
# The measurement that condemned them: `git ls-files` finds ZERO .py and ZERO
# .c/.h files here; the only mentions of Python and C in README.md are line
# 375, listing extensions the proof-debt hook can WATCH in someone else's
# project. `rolling-context` and `context-compression` are the subject of the
# sibling repo claude-rolling-context-Lean-4-, and appeared nowhere in this
# tree except the generated hashtag line itself. Somebody searching
# `topic:python` would have found a repository with no Python in it.
#
# `anthropic` stays: this repo is a plugin for Claude Code, which is
# Anthropic's product. That is a fact about this tree, not about a neighbour.
#
# The rule is now enforced by tags-consistency.sh phase 6: a tag that names a
# LANGUAGE must be backed by files of that language in `git ls-files`.
anthropic

# ===========================================================================
# TIER 3 -- [PROPERTIES]. GitHub ORG CUSTOM PROPERTIES.
# ===========================================================================
#
# Topics are free-text and crawlable; custom properties are a SCHEMA, defined
# once at the organisation level and given a value per repository. They are
# what an org uses to answer "which of our repos are actually verified" without
# reading forty READMEs.
#
# THE RULE THAT MATTERS HERE, and it is the same one that governs every theorem
# in this repository: A PROPERTY MUST NOT BE A SNAPSHOT THAT EXPIRES.
#
#   verify-command = bash checker/gate-all.sh --full     <- durable: an
#       INSTRUMENT. Still true after the hundredth theorem is added.
#   theorem-count  = 100                                 <- REJECTED, and this
#       is why the field does not exist: it is false the day someone proves
#       one more, and the obvious repair is to stop updating it. A number that
#       nothing re-derives is a claim, not a fact.
#
# `platforms` follows the same discipline in the other direction: it lists
# only what a runner has actually proved.
#
# HISTORY, kept because it is the whole argument for the rule. On 2026-08-01
# this read `linux,windows` and omitted macos, with the note "the day a macos
# job passes, the value moves -- not before". A macos-latest job was then added
# and FAILED inside two minutes: macOS ships bash 3.2.57 from 2007, and three
# checkers used `declare -A` and `mapfile`, both bash 4.0. Had the property
# been widened on the strength of "it should work", it would have been false
# for exactly as long as nobody looked.
#
# It is now `linux,windows,macos` because run 30687024111 went green on all
# three runners -- the value moved WITH the evidence, in the same edit, which
# is the only order that keeps a property honest.
#
# Format: name = value   (multi_select values are comma-separated)
# Applied and verified by .github/workflows/tag-manager.yml, which needs the
# API; checker/tags-consistency.sh checks the STRUCTURE locally, with no token.

[PROPERTIES]
verification = machine-checked-lean4
project-kind = claude-code-plugin
licence-model = agpl-3.0-or-eupl-1.2
maintenance = actively-developed
org-role = flagship
verify-command = bash checker/gate-all.sh --full
platforms = linux,windows,macos
